steps.what: Identify the actual proposed legislation, current law, explanatory material and relevant local/national evidence, checking the actual versions in {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual proposal, current text and genuine explanatory/impact sources
outputs: Actual selected source texts and version references

steps.what: Compare the actual current and proposed wording clause by clause using the native text-comparison feature in {DOCS}, preserving insertions, deletions and section references without inferring legal effect.
inputs: Actual selected current/proposed texts from s1

steps.what: Read and organise the actual supplied local and national impact claims against the changed clauses in {DOCS}, keeping source passages, assumptions and unresolved effects explicit.
outputs: Draft source-linked local/national issue comparison, not a final legal interpretation

loop.purpose: Organise supplied impact claims beside the actual changed clauses
loop.input: Actual fixed source package and exact comparison from s1-s2
loop.output: Working issue comparison quoting source passages and identifying unknown effects
loop.check: Legislator checks every claim/section link against the originals in s4 and retains all substantive assessment in s6
loop.stop: One pass and one correction; unsupported effect, missing source or version mismatch returns to manual reading/organisation
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native exact text comparison first; relating the supplied prose impact claims to clauses is not a literal text-difference operation.

steps.what: Check the actual clause/impact comparison against the original texts, verifying qualifications, quoted assumptions and omitted issues rather than accepting a summary as authoritative.
outputs: Actual verified working evidence and unresolved implications

steps.what: Discuss actual unresolved local and national implications with relevant policy, legal or affected-party contacts, testing assumptions and understanding competing accounts.
outputs: Actual clarified assumptions and remaining disagreements

steps.what: Analyse and understand the actual local and national implications of the proposed legislation, weighing the evidence, practical effects and uncertainty to form the legislator's own judgement.
inputs: Actual verified source evidence from s4
outputs: Actual human understanding of implications, trade-offs and unresolved effects

tasks.design: Use native textual comparison before a bounded source-linked reading aid. Preserve source selection, complete verification, actual consultation and the elected person's substantive judgement. The working comparison replaces actual manual comparison/organisation; it is not a newly required published impact report. No autonomous legal conclusion, vote or public message is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual clause differences and prose impact claims can require repeated manual cross-reference work before substantive analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native text comparison handles exact differences; a bounded reading aid can organise only the supplied claims with source passages.
tasks.still_hard: Formal wording, practical effects and competing local/national interests may point in different directions.
tasks.human_edge: Own the interpretation and political trade-offs rather than delegate them to a summary.

ambition.what: Consider an additional affected-group scenario once the actual sources are verified; extra analysis is not included as labour saving.

tasks.altitude: Set evidence and version standards for understanding a proposal.

evidence.claim: Exact text comparison and bounded source-linked organisation can assist legislative reading without deciding the proposal's implications.

assumptions: Conditional baseline actually performs manual clause comparison and impact-source organisation; shares are unmeasured active-work estimates.
The actual proposal and supporting papers are existing supplied records; s1 counts their selection and no fresh legal research source is invented.
All claim verification, actual consultation and substantive analysis remain; the 75% s3 remainder includes correction and manual fallback.
No extra report, official record write or outgoing message is established for this analysis task; none is added.
unknowns: Actual source comparability and existing comparison tools
research_questions: Replay a completed proposal review and identify actual comparison effort separately from understanding consequences.

already_counted.description: Actual sources, retained impact organisation/repair, complete verification, consultation and implication judgement

incremental.description: Maintain comparison settings and test source-link completeness after changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is a restructuring proposal with incompatible clause numbering and disputed or incomplete impact sources; both comparison and organisation remain manual and no change is adopted. With comparable actual texts and permitted supplied claims, remove 15 hours exact comparison plus 5 hours organisation, less 2 hours upkeep. Actual verification and all substantive local/national analysis remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the actual nominee files, leadership-post requirements and relevant appointment procedure, checking the actual candidate and role evidence.
inputs: Actual nominees, post requirements and appointment procedure
outputs: Actual understood nominee evidence and eligibility questions

steps.what: Consult the actual nominees and relevant colleagues through interviews or deliberation, testing leadership suitability and unresolved concerns without automated scoring.
inputs: Actual evidence and questions from s1
outputs: Actual clarified suitability concerns and views

steps.what: Decide whether to appoint nominees to leadership posts or approve the appointments under the actual elected office's authority and procedure.
inputs: Actual consultation and concerns from s2
outputs: Actual human appointment/approval decision or rejection

steps.what: Write the actual appointment or approval notice in {DOCS}, entering the decided nominee, post, terms and decision reference; a native notice template supplies fixed institutional headings only.
Check the actual completed notice against the actual appointment decision, procedure and named nominee recipient, authorising that final notice version for dispatch.
inputs: Actual decision and procedure from s1-s3
outputs: Final notice with version-and-recipient dispatch authorisation

steps.what: Save the actual final appointment notice in the same {DOCS} working record.
Send the actual final appointment/approval notice to the named nominee through {EMAIL}, only under the version-and-recipient authorisation from s5.
outputs: Actual notice delivered to the intended nominee

tasks.design: Retain all nominee assessment, consultation and appointment judgement. Reuse fixed notice headings only where the elected official actually writes and sends the appointment/approval notice. No automated candidate ranking or new personnel registry is proposed. The ordinary working-file save is ungated; the actual completed notice dispatch is separate and version-bound. Changed decision, notice or recipient returns to s5.
tasks.previous_blocker: A genuine appointment notice may repeat fixed institutional text after a human decision.
tasks.enabler_now: A native notice template supplies that small repeated heading block.
tasks.still_hard: Leadership suitability, public trust and the proper appointment procedure require actual accountable judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Own the actual appointment decision and explain it.

ambition.what: Make the existing actual appointment or approval.

tasks.altitude: Keep nominee evidence and formal decision responsibilities clear.

evidence.claim: Native notice headings can reduce repeated typing without selecting a leadership nominee or exercising appointment authority.

assumptions: Conditional workflow includes an actual notice prepared by the official; a vote-only role does not gain an invented clerical task.
Only 10% of notice writing is repeated headings; nominee, post, terms and decision content remain manual.
Shares are unmeasured appointment-cycle active-work estimates, not a daily administrative baseline.
No clerk labour or additional public publication process is removed or newly assigned.
unknowns: Actual official-versus-clerk notice responsibility and existing template use
research_questions: Trace an actual appointment and identify who really writes and dispatches the notice.

already_counted.description: Actual nominee review, consultation, appointment decision, substantive notice writing, final dispatch check, save and send

incremental.description: Maintain the small fixed institutional notice format

approvals.approved_version: Actual completed notice and named nominee recipient checked in s5; changes require s5 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is a vote-only official role or a notice already templated by the clerk; no clerical baseline is introduced and no change is claimed. If the official actually repeats the fixed notice headings, remove 1.5 hours of writing, less 0.5 hour upkeep. All actual assessment, decision, new notice content and the small save/send remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual pending-issue material and understand the colleagues' stated concerns before conferring about legislative positions and strategies.
inputs: Actual pending issues and existing colleague views
outputs: Actual understood issues and matters for discussion

steps.what: Confer with the actual colleagues to explore positions and strategies on the pending issues, listening, testing arguments and negotiating points of agreement and disagreement.
outputs: Actual deliberation and possible shared positions/strategies

steps.what: Formulate the actual positions and strategies with colleagues, deciding which commitments are agreed and which issues remain unresolved in the actual conversation.
inputs: Actual deliberation and possible agreements from s2
outputs: Actual human positions, strategies and unresolved disagreements

tasks.design: Retain actual issue reading and political deliberation. Native source search and agenda reuse were considered, but no distinct manual document assembly, written position statement, minutes or send is established in this conferring task. Do not add a new strategy record or record the private conversation merely to create software work. No autonomous commitment or public message is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreement depends on actual colleagues' concerns, trust and changing positions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing documents can support the discussion, but no changed actual action is established.
tasks.still_hard: The feasible strategy can change during the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise the meaning and limits of an actual colleague's commitment.

ambition.what: Confer on the existing actual pending issues.

tasks.altitude: Make the actual disagreements and commitment limits clear.

evidence.claim: Agenda or source-search aids do not themselves replace actual political deliberation and agreement.

assumptions: No distinct manual written statement, minutes, re-key or outgoing message is evidenced for this conversation; none is added.
The actual political commitment remains in the human conversation, with no model representing colleagues.
No saving is assigned to a sibling task or based on political work merely being classed human.
unknowns: Whether an actual separate written position is produced by this official in this activity
research_questions: Observe the real preparation and outputs, separating an actual written position if one exists rather than inventing it.

already_counted.description: Actual issue reading, conferring and agreement/strategy judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: After splitting actual reading, deliberation and formulation, no separately performed record, report or send is established. Native agenda/source aids remove no actual substantive reading or conversation in this baseline. No trailing written strategy record is invented; all work remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual proposal, current bill amendments, floor agenda and rules of procedure in {DOCS}; a native current-agenda link removes finding the current amendment reference while all substantive reading remains.
inputs: Actual current proposal/amendments, floor agenda and procedural rules
outputs: Actual understood debate text, current reference and procedure

steps.what: Prepare the actual arguments and speaking notes about the merits of the proposals and amendments, choosing the legislator's own reasoning and anticipated responses.
Debate the actual merits of proposals and bill amendments during floor sessions, following the actual rules of procedure and responding to other speakers' arguments and interventions.
inputs: Actual debate text and procedure from s1
outputs: Actual delivered debate contribution and live responses

tasks.design: Use a native current-agenda/amendment link only to reduce finding the right document reference. Keep all substantive proposal reading, actual argument/speaking-note preparation and live floor debate. Ordinary speaking-note retention stays within its writing step and earns no save benefit. The official session record remains the existing recording/clerk process, not new legislator labour; no automated speech, vote or public posting is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: The current amendment reference may be manually located within changing floor papers.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing agenda can link directly to the actual current amendment version.
tasks.still_hard: Arguments and procedural interventions can change during the actual floor session.
tasks.human_edge: Respond publicly to the actual debate and own the reasoning expressed.

ambition.what: Debate the existing actual proposals and amendments.

tasks.altitude: Keep current document references clear without delegating argument or procedure judgement.

evidence.claim: A native agenda link can reduce locating an amendment reference without reading its substance or debating its merits.

assumptions: Conditional baseline manually locates a current amendment reference; shares are active-work estimates.
Only 5% of the reading step is locating that reference; no substantive reading, argument writing or live debate is removed.
Actual speaking notes are preparation used in s3, not a trailing record nobody reads.
No legislator-prepared transcript, minutes or publication is assumed.
unknowns: Current agenda-link availability and actual reference-search effort
research_questions: Observe actual floor-paper preparation and determine whether current amendment references are already linked.

already_counted.description: Actual substantive reading, argument/speaking-note writing and live procedural debate

incremental.description: Check current-agenda link/version behaviour after changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case already links the current amendment or supplies paper floor papers without a compatible live agenda; no change is claimed. Where a real manual reference search exists, remove only 1 hour per 100, less 0.2 hour upkeep. Actual reading, speaking notes and floor debate remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Maintain sound evidence, document versions and clear responsibility while keeping elected judgement, appointments and deliberation human.
skills_to_grow: Distinguishing textual change from practical effect
role.ambitious_version: A legislator who reduces proven text comparison and repeated references while remaining responsible for implications, appointments, strategies and floor debate.
